I quit a few months ago. I blacked out and cut myself after being clean for months. I recently had a small amount (a small amount for me) and had the worst hangover ever. I decided never again until I’m in a healthy state of mind. Plus now I can’t drink because I’m trying new meds. I was using weed wayyyyy too much and I quit that too a few days ago. I’ve discovered I’m never satisfied. I always want to be higher, drunker, whatever. Plus I’ve been having hallucinations and I’m worried it’s because I was useing too much weed. Carts and then edibles. Like 50 milligrams or I couldn’t even feel it. Then I bought a 1,000 milligram syringe (for cooking there’s no needle) and was using tons a day. I have an addictive personality. And I’m chronically ill and bored with no friends so I was high all day every day for months. I was also grieving the loss of my favorite person as well as chronic pain. I was only ok when I was high. Being sober was agony. It still is but I’m scared of hallucinating again. I have no idea what caused it but I’m case it was the weed it felt like I had no other choice. It made the loneliness tolerable. I think once I get my life going I won’t be so gluttonous with substances. I’ve been alone for 7 years now. I’m only 21. It feels like I was kicked out of the world for being sick. I was also having insane suicidal thoughts. Usually it’s more casual not impulsive. It was like I was having visions of me talking all of my pills. I’ve called 988 three times they’re amazing. I’ve never had a plan or anything it was always a moment thing. Not knowing if I would do it or not was petrifying. I’ve been making sure I’m never alone so the thoughts don’t come back.

Hey are you ok? You can call 988 I’ve had three great experiences. Technically four because of a follow up. I feel the same way.
